title: Temporal privilege playback & compact audit stream prototype
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Design a compact, timeline-first audit stream and a temporal-privilege playback panel for the Redwood Console. The goal is to let security auditors and workspace admins quickly inspect who had which permissions when, replay changes across time ranges, and correlate access events with cost and rollout data. Deliverables: Figma prototype (desktop + narrow), interaction spec for temporal playback, accessibility checklist, and handoff tokens for engineering. This ticket focuses on UX flows, information density trade-offs, and filtering affordances; it does not include backend schema changes or final RBAC enforcement rules.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype with a timeline scrubber that replays permission grants/revocations over a selectable date range
Compact audit rows with inline context: actor, action, object, resulting role, duration, and related rollout id
Filter set for actor, role, workspace, date range, and cost bucket with saved-view capability
Design spec documents mapping visual states to query parameters for engineering handoff
Usability test (n=6) completed with identified top 3 friction points and design iterations captured
